i.norm: Convert a small negative NTFS timestamp to a FileTime (near the NTFS epoch)

Shift the FileTime backward by the Unix-to-NTFS epoch offset (expressed as nanoseconds). FileTimes.UNIX_TO_NTFS_OFFSET is -116444736000000000L (100-ns intervals), so multiplied by 100 gives the nanosecond equivalent; here we pass the raw offset value directly as nanoseconds, which moves the instant further into the past.
The shifted time must differ from the original because the offset is non-zero
